arXiv:2606.32034v1 [cs.LG] 2026 年 6 月 30 日arXiv:2606.32034v1 [cs.LG] 30 Jun 2026

有效值QVal：廉价评估长期 LLM 代理人的密集监督信号: Cheaply Evaluating Dense Supervision Signals for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

Sergio Hernández-Gutiérrez1  Matteo Merler 2  Ilze Amanda Auzina1∗
Joschka Strüber1  Ameya Prabhu1†  Matthias Bethge1†
1Tübingen AI Center, University of Tübingen  2Fondazione Bruno Kessler Equal Contribution   †Equal Advising   Correspondence to: sergio.hernandez@bethgelab.org
摘要Abstract

LLM 代理越来越多地在长视野中行动，其中单个轨迹可以包含数百或数千个行动。 在这些设置中，仅结果奖励提供的指导过于稀疏，无法告知模型中间行动的优点。 密集监督方法旨在通过对中间步骤进行评分来解决这个问题，从内在信心到自我蒸馏和嵌入相似性。 然而，通常的做法是通过测量集成它们的训练管道的下游性能来评估它们。 这是昂贵的，将监督质量与培训工程混杂因素混为一谈，并且使得需要不同培训设置的不同方法系列变得无法比较。 因此，密集的监督方法很少以共同点为基准。 我们介绍LLM agents increasingly act over long horizons, where a single trajectory can contain hundreds or thousands of actions. In these settings, outcome-only rewards provide too sparse guidance, failing to inform the model about the goodness of intermediate actions. Dense supervision methods aim to solve this problem by scoring intermediate steps, from intrinsic confidence to self-distillation and embedding similarities. However, it is common practice to evaluate them by measuring the downstream performance of a training pipeline that integrates them. This is expensive, conflates supervision quality with training engineering confounders, and renders different methodological families requiring distinct training setups incomparable. As a result, dense supervision methods are rarely benchmarked on common ground. We introduce有效值QVal，一个免训练的测试平台，用于直接评估密集的监督信号。 给定状态-动作对，, a training-free testbed for directly evaluating dense supervision signals. Given a state-action pair,有效值QVal衡量方法的得分有多好measures how well a method’s score isQQ-对齐-aligned：是否根据: whether it orders actions according to theQQ-强有力的参考政策的价值观。 这使我们可以在任何训练运行之前比较信号，并将信号质量与其他工程选择分开。 我们实例化-values of a strong reference-policy. This lets us compare signals before any training run and separate signal quality from other engineering choices. We instantiate有效值QVal as 有效值QVal-v1.0，对四种不同环境和七个方法系列中的 21 种密集监督方法进行基准测试，并在六个开放权重模型主干上进行了超过 1.2K 次评估实验。 我们发现，简单的激励基线始终优于文献中最近的密集监督方法，并且表现与家庭密切相关。 这些发现适用于模型大小、环境和观察方式。-v1.0, benchmarking 21 dense supervision methods across four diverse environments and seven methodological families, with over 1.2K evaluation experiments across six open-weight model backbones. We find that simple prompting baselines consistently outperform recent dense supervision methods from the literature, and that performance clusters strongly by family. These findings hold across model sizes, environments, and observation modalities.有效值QVal旨在轻松扩展到新的环境和方法，使研究人员能够在任何训练运行之前迭代密集的监督方法。is designed to be easily extensible to new environments and methods, enabling researchers to iterate on dense supervision methods before any training run.

1 简介Introduction

大型语言模型 (LLM) 越来越多地充当编写代码、操作图形界面和导航模拟环境的代理。 这些是长期任务，单个轨迹可以跨越数百或数千个动作。 随着视野的增长，稀疏的奖励使得学习变得棘手：基于结果的奖励几乎无法对各个步骤的优点提供指导，更重要的是，如果任务超出了模型能力的边界，则可能永远不会被观察到。 当前用于 LLM 后期培训的强化学习 (RL) 算法主要依赖于基于采样的值估计。例如，GRPOLarge Language Models (LLMs) increasingly act as agents that write code, operate graphical interfaces, and navigate simulated environments. These are long-horizon tasks, where a single trajectory can span hundreds or thousands of actions. Sparse rewards make learning intractable as horizons grow: an outcome-based reward gives little guidance about the goodness of individual steps and, more critically, it may never be observed if the task is beyond the frontier of the model’s capabilities. Current Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithms for LLM post-training primarily rely on sampling-based value estimation. For example, GRPO(Shao et al., 2024)通过比较组内的样本来估计完成的价值。 当轨迹很短时，这种方法效果最好，只需要合理数量的样本来归因哪些操作导致了结果。 然而，智能体轨迹越来越多地涉及多步骤工具的使用、递归分解和上下文压缩；随着这些长度的增长，结果奖励变得不足，并且基于群体的估计者无法确定哪些行动对最终结果做出了贡献。estimates the value of a completion by comparing samples within a group. This works best when trajectories are short, where only a reasonable number of samples is needed to attribute which actions caused the outcome. However, agent trajectories increasingly involve multi-step tool use, recursive decomposition, and context compaction; as these grow in length outcome rewards become insufficient, and group-based estimators do not identify which actions contributed to the final outcome.

这激发了产生密集监督信号的方法。其中包括沿着推理轨迹从令牌概率导出的信号This has motivated methods that produce dense supervision signals. These include signals derived from token probabilities along reasoning traces(Yoon et al., 2026), 工具调用, tool calls(Xie et al., 2026)，或者交互反馈, or interaction feedback(Auzina et al., 2026)以及自蒸馏方法，从模型生成的判断或目标中得出中间监督, as well as self-distillation approaches, which derive intermediate supervision from model-generated judgments or targets(Hübotter et al., 2026; Shenfeld et al., 2026; Song et al., 2026)。 尽管这些方法在构建分数的方式上有所不同，并且很大程度上是单独开发和评估的，但它们都有一个共同的目标：为中间状态或动作分配有用的值。 因此，我们将它们作为一类常见的类别来研究. Although these methods differ in how they construct their scores, and have largely been developed and evaluated in isolation, they all share the goal of assigning useful values to intermediate states or actions. We therefore study them as a common class of密集监管方式dense supervision methods并根据每种方法获取信号的方式将它们分组。and group them into families according to how each method obtains its signal.

综合评估的主要瓶颈是我们缺乏一种廉价且直接的方法来比较密集的监督信号。如今，通过将方法集成到训练后管道中并测量下游性能改进来评估方法。这是昂贵的，并且由于不同方法所需的不同设置而通常无法实现。 这进一步使得结果难以解释：测量的增益将监督质量和用于 RL 训练的其他工程选择混为一谈，例如算法或优化特征、归一化技术、损失函数集成策略以及与其他训练信号的平衡。 我们提出以下研究问题：The primary bottleneck towards comprehensive evaluation is that we lack a cheap and direct way to compare dense supervision signals. Today, a method is evaluated by integrating it into a post-training pipeline and measuring the downstream performance improvement. This is expensive, and often unachievable due to the distinct setups required by different methods. It further makes the results hard to interpret: the measured gain conflates the supervision quality and other engineering choices used for RL training, such as algorithmic or optimization features, normalization techniques, loss-function integration strategies, and balancing with other training signals. We pose the following research question:

我们可以单独评估密集的监督信号吗？Can we evaluate dense supervision signals in isolation,
在任何昂贵的训练后跑步之前？before any expensive post-training runs?

我们介绍We introduce有效值QVal，价格便宜，免培训, a cheap, training-free试验台testbed用于密集的监督方法。这使得研究人员能够快速迭代新方法及其变体，在将候选信号集成到训练后管道之前对其进行评估。密集信号除了训练之外也很重要：它们可以在测试时指导搜索，包括树搜索或 MCTS 式的推出。for dense supervision methods. This enables researchers to iterate on new approaches and their variants quickly, evaluating candidate signals before integrating them into post-training pipelines. Dense signals also matter beyond training: they can guide search at test time, including tree search or MCTS-style rollouts.

有效值QVal设计简单，如图has a simple design, shown in Figure1。对于给定的环境，我们构建一个数据集，其中每个样本都是状态-动作对. For a given environment, we construct a dataset where each sample is a state-action pair(s,a)(s,a)标有一个labelled with a参考referenceQQ-值-value: 继续的轨迹的预期回报: the expected return of the trajectory that continues from(s,a)(s,a)在专家的指导下under an expert参考政策reference policy。 我们从存在最优策略的最优策略或不存在最优策略的前沿模型中获得该专家，并从几次推出中的最佳策略中估计价值（第 1 节）. We obtain this expert from either an optimal policy where one exists, or a frontier model where it does not, estimating the value from the best of several rollouts (Section3）。 我们通过对每个样本进行评分来评估方法). We evaluate a method by scoring every sample by itsQQ-对齐-alignment：其预测分数相对于参考对样本进行排序的程度如何: how well its predicted scores order the samples relative to the referenceQQ-价值观。 因为每种方法都会看到相同的输入，并根据相同的目标进行判断，具有固定的模型和提示上下文，-values. Because every method sees the same inputs and is judged against the same targets, with fixed models and prompt context,有效值QVal将信号本身的质量与训练管道的混杂因素隔离开来，从而以廉价的方式早期指示该方法是否提供了可行的学习信号。isolates the quality of the signal itself from the confounders of a training pipeline, giving a cheap early indication of whether the method provides a viable learning signal.

我们将该方法实例化为We instantiate this methodology as有效值QVal-v1.0，发布时涵盖了跨文本和视觉领域的四个多轮环境：TerminalBench 中的编程和代理终端交互-v1.0, which at release covers four multi-turn environments across text and visual domains: programming and agentic terminal interaction in TerminalBench(Merrill et al., 2025)、OpenApps 中的计算机和应用程序使用, computer and application use in OpenApps(Ullrich et al., 2026), ALFWorld 中的具身推理, embodied reasoning in ALFWorld(Shridhar et al., 2020)，以及 FrozenLake 中的目标导向导航, and goal-directed navigation in FrozenLake(Towers et al., 2025)。对于每个环境，我们收集状态-动作对并提供参考. For each environment, we collect state-action pairs and provide referenceQQ-价值观。我们使用这些数据集来评估涵盖七个方法家族的 21 种密集监督方法：直接提示-values. We use these datasets to evaluate 21 dense supervision methods spanning seven methodological families: direct prompting(Liu et al., 2023; Ma et al., 2024), 内在信号, intrinsic signals(Auzina et al., 2026; Kwok et al., 2026)、代码生成, code generation(Ma et al., 2023b; Li et al., 2024), 自蒸馏, self-distillation(Hübotter et al., 2026)、基于排名的预测、预训练模型, ranking-based prediction, pre-trained models(Ma et al., 2022, 2023a)，以及嵌入相似度, and embedding similarity(Rocamonde et al., 2024; Baumli et al., 2023).

我们发现显着差异We find substantial differences inQQ-跨方法的一致性。平均而言，直接提示和排名方法表现最佳，并且表现通常按方法系列进行聚类。基于代码的方法在更小、更结构化的环境中表现良好，但在我们研究的更开放的环境中表现不佳。与更简单的变体相比，族内增加的复杂性很少能改善一致性。我们还发现这些模式不能用环境难度的单一排序来解释：不同的家庭对状态空间、行动空间、观察模式和可用反馈的反应不同。在我们的实验中，文本观察通常比图像观察产生更强的对齐，而方法的相对顺序在动作值和状态值目标中很大程度上得到保留。-alignment across methods. Direct prompting and ranking methods perform best on average, and performance often clusters by methodological family. Code-based methods perform well in the smaller, more structured environments but weaken in the more open-ended settings we study. Added complexity within a family rarely improves alignment over simpler variants. We also find that these patterns are not explained by a single ordering of environment difficulty: different families respond differently to the state space, action space, observation modality, and available feedback. Text observations generally produce stronger alignment than image observations in our experiments, while the relative ordering of methods is largely preserved across action-value and state-value targets.

总之，我们做出了三项主要贡献。首先我们介绍一下In summary, we make three main contributions. First, we introduce有效值QVal，免训练 通过其评估密集监督方法的测试床, a training-free testbed that evaluates dense supervision methods by theirQQ-对齐-alignment, 怎么样 他们的分数根据参考对行动进行排序, how well their scores order actions according to referenceQQ-跨文本和视觉领域的值（部分-values, across text and visual domains (Section2）。它提供了一个共同的比较基础，使信号质量的测量成本低廉，并将测量结果与后来集成到训练管道中的过程分开。其次，我们探索如何注释来自四种不同环境的状态-动作对的多模态数据集，即如何生成参考). It provides a common comparison ground, makes signal quality cheap to measure, and separates that measurement from later integration into training pipelines. Second, we explore how to annotate multimodal datasets of state-action pairs from four diverse environments, i.e., how to generate the referenceQQ-值，导致-values, resulting in有效值QVal-v1.0（节-v1.0 (Section3）。第三，我们对 21 种密集监督方法进行了基准测试，这些方法分为 7 个系列，涵盖从 9B 到 122B 参数的 6 个开放权重骨干网，进行了超过 1.2K 次实验（第 1.2 节）). Third, we benchmark 21 dense supervision methods, grouped into seven families, across six open-weight backbones from 9B to 122B parameters, for more than 1.2K experiments (Section4).

有效值QVal是为了成长而建造的。相同的收集和标签程序可以轻松扩展到新环境。一种新方法只需为每个状态-动作对提供一个分数即可进行直接比较。我们将继续扩大is built to grow. The same collection and labelling procedure can be easily extended to new environments. A new method only needs to provide one score per state-action pair to allow direct comparisons. We will continue expanding有效值QVal随着新的代理基准的出现。从业者还可以使用我们的框架为自己的训练后流程中重要的任务和环境构建评估数据集。as new agentic benchmarks emerge. Practitioners can also use our framework to build evaluation datasets for the tasks and environments that matter in their own post-training pipelines.

2 有效值QVal：密集监督方法的免培训测试平台: A Training-Free Testbed for Dense Supervision Methods

密集监督主要应该预测代理人的最终成功。单一的长期轨迹包含许多行动，而孤立地看起来合理的行动仍然可能使最终目标更难实现。密集监督方法对每个中间动作进行评分，因此评分只有在反映了情况时才有用Dense supervision should primarily predict the eventual success of an agent. A single long-horizon trajectory contains many actions, and one that looks reasonable in isolation can still make the final goal harder to reach. Dense supervision methods score each intermediate action, so a score is only useful if it reflects决定的结果where a decision leads而不是它在当地看起来有多好。rather than how good it looks locally.有效值QVal问题正是这样的：一种方法是否会为更有可能获得最终成功的行为分配更高的分数？asks exactly this: does a method assign higher scores to the actions that make eventual success more likely?

A signal that orders actions by their return will provide meaningful supervision at every step a policy takes during training, and one that orders them poorly must rely on other mechanisms to be useful, so alignment is a cheap early indicator of whether a signal carries the information needed for successful supervision.

QQ-对齐（等式-alignment (Eq.2）是一个理论属性：信号要么是严格的 增加变换) is a theoretical property: a signal either is a strictly increasing transform ofQπQ^{\pi}，或者不是。在实践中，我们想要测量, or it is not. In practice, we want to measure the学位degree其中一个方法是to which a method isQQ-根据我们的参考政策进行调整-aligned under our reference policiesπ\pi。因此，我们通过预测分数和参考标签之间的排名相关性来评估每种方法。 预测存在于不兼容的尺度上（例如，原始 LLM 分数、代码生成的输出、令牌对数概率、嵌入距离），这些尺度不能置于常见损失之下，因此我们通过它们引起的顺序而不是绝对值来比较方法。这与最近的证据一致，即即使绝对分数校准不佳，LLM 和 VLM 法官也会可靠地对候选人进行排序. We thus evaluate each method by the rank correlation between its predicted scores and the reference labels. Predictions live on incompatible scales (e.g., raw LLM scores, code-generated outputs, token log-probabilities, embedding distances) that cannot be placed under a common loss, so we compare methods by the ordering they induce rather than by absolute values. This is consistent with recent evidence that LLM and VLM judges order candidates reliably even when their absolute scores are poorly calibrated(Kumar et al., 2026)。 我们报告斯皮尔曼的. Both lie in[−1,1][-1,1]并测量单调一致性；它们在异常值敏感性方面有所不同，斯皮尔曼以一些顺序不良的对为主，而肯德尔对每个反演的权重相等。 对于输出某个状态下候选动作的排列而不是每个点的值的方法，我们计算每个状态内的预测排列和标签引起的排列之间的等级相关性以及跨状态的平均值。 附录and measure monotonic agreement; they differ in outlier sensitivity, with Spearman dominated by a few badly-ordered pairs and Kendall weighting every inversion equally. For methods that output a permutation over the candidate actions at a state, rather than a value per point, we compute the rank correlation between the predicted and the label-induced permutation within each state and average across states. 数据收集。Data collection.对于每个环境，我们收集轨迹和样本For each environment, we collect trajectories and sampleNN总共状态-动作对（表state-action pairs in total (Table2、附录, AppendixA）。 我们的目标不是在收集过程中最大限度地提高任务成功率；相反，我们优先考虑多样性，包括高价值和低价值的状态和行动。 对于 OpenApps 和 FrozenLake，我们使用旨在次优的脚本化策略来最大化覆盖范围。 对于 TerminalBench 和 ALFWorld，我们使用 DeepSeek v3.2 生成轨迹). We do not aim to maximize task success during collection; instead, we prioritize diversity, including both high- and low-value states and actions. For OpenApps and FrozenLake, we use scripted policies designed to be sub-optimal to maximize coverage. For TerminalBench and ALFWorld, we generate trajectories with DeepSeek v3.2(DeepSeek-AI et al., 2025)。 为了进一步提高多样性，我们从每个轨迹中间的范围中选择一组有限的状态动作对。 这种启发式方法删除了几乎没有价值预测信号的数据点：非常早的状态通常发生在有意义的任务进展之前，而非常晚的状态接近终止，因此大多数操作具有相似的值。 我们还为每个状态采样了三个替代操作（每个状态总共四个操作），这允许方法在相同上下文下对候选操作进行排名。 附录. To further improve diversity, we select a limited set of state-action pairs from a range in the middle of each trajectory. This heuristic removes data-points that carry little signal for value prediction: very early states often occur before meaningful task progress, while very late states are close to termination, so most actions have similar value. We also sample three alternative actions for each state (totalling four actions per state), which allows methods to rank candidate actions under the same context. 自蒸馏法Self-distillation methods根据模型的可能性对候选动作进行评分 一旦看到有关该操作结果的其他特权信息，就会产生该操作。 直觉是，事后看来，当一个好的行动对它有利时，它就更有可能发生。 结果会被显示，而糟糕的行动却不会。这与内在评分方法不同，内在评分方法读取模型针对专门提示询问代理成功而不是行动本身的概率。 该系列包含两个离线重新排名信号：score a candidate action by how much more likely the model is to have produced that action once it sees additional privileged information about the action’s outcome. The intuition is that a good action becomes more probable in hindsight when its favorable outcome is shown, whereas a poor action does not. This differs from the intrinsic scoring methods, which read the model’s probability for a dedicated prompt asking about the agent’s success rather than over the action itself. In visual domains, we evaluate the same prompt-based method families as in the text setting; we keep the same context but provide states as images rather than textual descriptions.

This shows that our TerminalBench results are robust across two frontier models with independent training recipes, and the labels capture a stable notion of downstream task progress across strong model policies.

4.3 讨论Discussion

信号与训练后功效的相关性。Correlation of signals with post-training efficacy. 有效值QVal提供了一种有原则且廉价的方法来单独评估密集监督方法的一致性。尽管如此，信号质量并不是影响 RL 训练后运行有效性的唯一因素，而且它也不是与管道的其余部分隔离的。当通过 Q 对齐直接比较方法时，简单的直接值预测具有惊人的竞争力，优于更专业的机制。还必须研究我们在评估信号时想要将信号从中分离出来的混杂元素（例如，优化和算法选择、将信号集成到损失函数中的策略、与其他信号的相互作用等），以构建成功的训练后系统。此外，一些与特定环境目标不太相符的信号可能仍然对学习代理有利（例如，探索激励）。因此，未来的工作在评估信号质量时应将直接提示作为基线。provides a principled and cheap approach to evaluating the alignment of dense supervision methods in isolation. Nonetheless, the quality of a signal is not the only component impacting the effectiveness of RL post-training runs, and it is not isolated from the rest of the pipeline. When methods are compared directly through Q-alignment, simple direct value prediction is surprisingly competitive, outperforming more specialized mechanisms. The confounding elements we want to isolate the signal from when evaluating it (e.g., optimization and algorithmic choices, strategies for integrating the signal into the loss function, interactions with other signals, etc.) must also be studied to build successful post-training systems. Furthermore, some signals that poorly align with a particular environmental objective might still be beneficial to learning agents (e.g., exploration incentives). Therefore, future work should treat direct prompting as a baseline when evaluating signal quality.

跨模式的信息。Information across modalities.同时，我们的结果必须通过每种方法可用的信息来解释。基于文本的提示通常接收紧凑的状态和任务抽象，而仅视觉的方法仅接收像素和目标规范，这使得它们更通用但性能较差。因此，它们较弱的对齐并不表明视觉反馈本质上较差。相反，它强调价值估计通常需要正确的抽象，特别是当进展依赖于符号、关系或隐藏状态信息时。我们的稳健性分析通过表明模态和信号类型影响来为这一观点提供早期支持。At the same time, our results must be interpreted through the information available to each method. Text-based prompting often receives compact state and task abstractions, whereas vision-only methods only receive pixels and a goal specification, making them more versatile but less performant. Their weaker alignment therefore does not show that visual feedback is intrinsically inferior; rather, it highlights that value estimation often requires the right abstraction, especially when progress depends on symbolic, relational, or hidden state information. Our robustness analyses provide early support for this view by suggesting that modality and signal type affectQQ-对齐。-alignment.

总体而言，Overall,有效值QVal表明新的密集监督方法应该通过改善底层信号（而不仅仅是下游性能）来证明其增加的复杂性是合理的，并提供一种廉价的诊断，可以根据suggests that new dense supervision methods should justify their added complexity by improving the underlying signal, not just downstream performance, and provides a cheap diagnostic that filters candidates based onQQ- 在昂贵的训练运行之前进行调整，而不是替换它们。-alignment before expensive training runs, rather than replacing them.

5 相关作品Related Works

通过培训进行评估。Evaluation through training.大多数密集反馈方法是通过使用下游训练或选择管道内的建议信号并报告任务返回或通过率改进来评估的。例如，指导推理搜索的自我评估信号通常仅通过最终任务准确性来验证Most dense feedback methods are evaluated by using the proposed signal inside a downstream training or selection pipeline and reporting task return, or pass-rate improvements. For instance, self-evaluation signals that guide reasoning search are typically validated only by final task accuracy(Xie et al., 2023)，并且生成验证器通过固定推理预算下的下游选择准确性进行评估, and generative verifiers are assessed by downstream selection accuracy under a fixed inference budget(Singhi et al., 2025)。尽管这展示了端到端的实用性，但它使得信号质量难以隔离：测量的增益取决于策略模型、优化器、探索过程、环境分布、生成的数据量以及训练循环的实现细节。一些工作在受限环境中更直接地评估进度或奖励模型质量，特别是在机器人和视觉进度估计中. Although this demonstrates end-to-end utility, it makes signal quality hard to isolate: measured gains depend on the policy model, optimizer, exploration process, environment distribution, amount of generated data, and implementation details of the training loop. Some work evaluates progress or reward-model quality more directly in restricted settings, especially in robotics and visual progress estimation(Ma et al., 2024; Budzianowski et al., 2026; Roy et al., 2025). 有效值QVal是互补的：作为一个免训练的测试平台，它不会询问完整的训练方案是否有所改进，而是修复数据集、模型主干和环境上下文，然后直接测量提议的密集信号顺序状态或动作是否与从参考延续派生的值标签一致。is complementary: as a training-free testbed, rather than asking whether a full training recipe improves, it fixes datasets, model backbones, and environment context, then directly measures whether a proposed dense signal orders states or actions consistently with value labels derived from reference continuations.

奖励和批评基准。Reward and critic benchmarks.关于评估语言和视觉语言系统的奖励模型和批评模型的文献也越来越多。 RewardBench、RM-Bench 和 RewardBench 2 通过响应比较或基于准确性的任务（涵盖聊天、推理、安全、细微错误和风格偏差）来评估奖励模型There is also a growing literature on evaluating reward models and critic models for language and vision-language systems. RewardBench, RM-Bench, and RewardBench 2 evaluate reward models with response-comparison or accuracy-based tasks spanning chat, reasoning, safety, subtle errors, and style biases(Lambert et al., 2024; Liu et al., 2024; Malik et al., 2025)。 VL-RewardBench 和 Multimodal RewardBench 将这种评估方式扩展到多模式奖励模型和 VLM 法官. VL-RewardBench and Multimodal RewardBench extend this style of evaluation to multimodal reward models and VLM judges(Li et al., 2025; Yasunaga et al., 2025)。 ProcessBench 和 PRMBench 评估模型识别错误推理步骤的能力. ProcessBench and PRMBench evaluate models’ ability to identify erroneous reasoning steps(Zheng et al., 2025; Song et al., 2025), CriticBench 评估模型批判和纠正解决方案的能力, CriticBench evaluates models’ ability to critique and correct solutions(Lin et al., 2024)，而 AgentRewardBench 研究完整网络代理轨迹的自动评估, while AgentRewardBench studies automatic evaluation of complete web-agent trajectories(Lù et al., 2025)。这些基准在精神上密切相关，但它们主要评估最终反应、成对偏好、批评、步骤级正确性标签或整体轨迹判断。. These benchmarks are closely related in spirit, but they primarily assess final responses, pairwise preferences, critiques, step-level correctness labels, or whole-trajectory judgments.有效值QVal相反，为多轮代理训练所需的中间信号提供了一个测试平台，在交互式环境中测量每个状态和每个动作与值标签的对齐情况。instead provides a testbed for the intermediate signal needed for multi-turn agent training, measuring per-state and per-action alignment with value labels in interactive environments.

6 结论Conclusion

我们介绍We introduce有效值QVal，一种评估密集监督方法的免训练方法 由他们的, a training-free methodology that evaluates dense supervision methods by theirQQ-对齐-alignment，他们的分数对代理人的中间行动的排名如何 根据参考值，将曾经需要训练的问题变成了 便宜的评价。 我们将其实例化为, how well their scores rank an agent’s intermediate actions according to reference values, turning a question that once required a training run into a cheap evaluation. We instantiate it as有效值QVal-v1.0，对跨四个环境和六个开放权重主干的文献中涵盖七个系列的 21 种方法进行基准测试。 我们发现简单的直接提示提供了最强的信号，并且该方法按家族可靠地聚类，在模型大小、环境、模式和目标类型上稳健地聚类。-v1.0, benchmarking 21 methods spanning seven families from the literature across four environments and six open-weight backbones. We find that simple direct prompting provides the strongest signal and that methods cluster reliably by family, robustly across model sizes, environments, modalities, and target types.有效值QVal旨在不断发展：我们将不断通过新的最先进的环境和领域来扩展它，通过为每个状态-动作对发出单个分数来插入新方法，并且从业者可以应用我们的方法来为自己的任务构建数据集。 我们希望is built to grow: we will keep extending it with new state-of-the-art environments and domains, new methods plug in by emitting a single score per state-action pair, and practitioners can apply our methodology to build datasets for their own tasks. We hope有效值QVal支持对训练长视野智能体所需的密集信号进行更快、更便宜的迭代。supports faster, cheaper iteration on the dense signals needed to train long-horizon agents.

A.1 终端工作台TerminalBench

我们使用We use the容易easyTBLite的难度划分difficulty split of TBLite[OpenThoughts-Agent team, 2026]，TerminalBench 的精选子集, a curated subset of TerminalBench[Merrill et al., 2025]专为终端代理的迭代而设计。我们特别选择 TBLite 而不是完整的 TerminalBench，因为我们发现即使是当前最好的模型也无法解决许多任务，主要是由于超时取消了长时间操作（例如，R 中的包安装）。该拆分包含 19 项任务，涵盖系统管理、加密、日志处理、数据工程和 ML 管道任务。这19项任务是：designed for iteration on terminal agents. We specifically choose TBLite over the full TerminalBench as we find many tasks to be unsolvable even by the best current models, mostly due to timeouts cancelling long operations (e.g., package installs in R). The split contains 19 tasks spanning system administration, cryptography, log processing, data engineering, and ML pipeline tasks. The 19 tasks are:娱乐安装amuse-install, 破碎的蟒蛇broken-python, 构建-merkle-tree-cli-sha512build-merkle-tree-cli-sha512, 卷积层convolutional-layers, 联合签名无密钥签名cosign-keyless-signing, 密码协议验证器cryptographic-protocol-verifier, Hydra 调试 slurm 模式hydra-debug-slurm-mode, 图像瓦片识别image-tile-identification, jq-数据处理jq-data-processing, jsonl 聚合器jsonl-aggregator, 日志摘要log-summary, mlflow-寄存器mlflow-register, pandas-etl, 扑克牌识别playing-card-recognition, 蛋白质序列protein-sequence, 筏日志修复并发访问raft-log-repair-concurrent-access, 日程安排-假期schedule-vacation, 微笑数据实验室smiles-data-lab, 系统日志监控systemd-log-monitoring.

参考政策。Reference policy.

对于 TerminalBench，最佳策略是使用单个（通常是复杂的）命令来解决每个任务；近似这样的策略对于实际应用来说是不可取的，因为它会导致更难以解释、不太人性化、更容易出错的动作，并且可能产生训练有素的模型，而这些模型缺乏组合技能来泛化到更长、更复杂的基于终端的任务。因此，我们选择采用最大值蒙特卡罗方法：使用更理想的参考策略，我们完成For TerminalBench, an optimal policy would solve every task using a single, most often convoluted command; approximating such a policy would not be desirable for practical applications, as it would result in actions which are harder to interpret, less human-aligned, more error-prone, and could yield trained models that would lack the compositional skills to generalize to longer and more complex terminal-based tasks. Therefore, we choose to employ a Max-Value Monte Carlo approach: using a more desirable reference policy, we completekk给定状态的轨迹，并将数据点的值估计为任何轨迹获得的最高折扣累积奖励。为了确保标签的高质量，我们限制参考策略最多解决数据集中的每个任务trajectories from the given state and estimate the value of the data point as the highest discounted cumulative reward attained by any trajectory. In order to ensure the high quality of our labels, we constrain the reference policy to solve every task in the dataset in at mostkk尝试，其中attempts, wherekk是通过蒙特卡罗采样的推出数量。对于 TerminalBench，我们使用 GPT-5.5is the number of rollouts sampled via Monte Carlo. For TerminalBench, we use GPT-5.5[OpenAI, 2026]和样品and samplek=16k=16推出。我们观察到 GPT-5.5 获得了 Pass@16rollouts. We observe that GPT-5.5 obtains a Pass@16 of100%100\%在我们的 TerminalBench 任务子集上。 此外，我们进一步验证了我们的参考策略，表明作为蒙特卡罗骨干的不同模型不会改变我们的基准测试结果on our subset of TerminalBench tasks. Additionally, we further validate our reference policy by showing that different models serving as the Monte Carlo backbones do not alter the results of our benchmark in Section4.2.

A.3 阿尔夫世界ALFWorld

阿尔夫世界ALFWorld[Shridhar et al., 2020]调整体现的雷神 模拟器aligns the embodied THOR simulator[Kolve et al., 2017]具有 TextWorld 界面，通过自然语言观察和代理以自我为中心的观点的渲染图像来揭示家务任务。with a TextWorld interface, exposing household tasks through both natural-language observations and rendered images of the agent’s egocentric view.

任务范围。Task scope.

ALFWorld定义了六种任务类型 （ALFWorld defines six task types (拾取和放置pick_and_place, 酷和地方cool_and_place, 加热并放置heat_and_place, 清理并放置clean_and_place, 检查并放置examine_and_place, 挑选两个并放置pick_two_and_place）。在视觉模式下产生可靠的专家政策基础事实需要一个在 底层模拟器状态，由 ALFWorld 提供。根据经验，我们发现规划器在以下方面是稳健的). Producing reliable expert-policy ground-truth under the visual modality requires a planner that operates on the underlying simulator state, provided by ALFWorld. Empirically, we find the planner to be robust on拾取和放置pick_and_place但与视觉渲染管道配合使用时，其他五种类型的性能会下降；为了保持地面实况质量一致高，因此我们限制我们的but to degrade on the other five types when paired with the visual rendering pipeline; to keep ground-truth quality uniformly high we therefore restrict our有效值QVal数据集到dataset to挑选和放置_简单pick_and_place_simple。然而，这种单一类型中的任务多样性是巨大的：数据集跨越. 比较。Comparison.

这两个指标都取值Both metrics take values in[−1,1][-1,1]: 11表示完全序数一致，denotes perfect ordinal agreement,−1-1完全反转，并且a complete inversion, and0没有单调关联。他们的惩罚方式有所不同。 Spearman 聚合了排名差异的平方，因此排序非常错误的一对（例如，最大的标签与最小的预测配对）主导了得分；无论排名中的点相距多远，Kendall 都会以相同的权重对每个成对反转进行计数，这使得它对极端异常值更加稳健，但通常会产生比no monotonic association. They differ in what they penalise. Spearman aggregates squared rank differences, so a pair that is ordered very wrong (e.g., the largest label paired with the smallest prediction) dominates the score; Kendall counts each pairwise inversion with equal weight regardless of how far apart the points are in the ranking, making it more robust to extreme outliers but typically yielding smaller absolute values thanρ\rho在相同的数据上。我们报告了两者：Spearman 对值分布尾部的局部误差更敏感，而 Kendall 提供了对单调一致性的更严格、无标度的解读。on the same data. We report both: Spearman is more sensitive to localised errors at the tails of the value distribution, while Kendall provides a stricter, scale-free reading of monotonic agreement.

    开放应用程序OpenApps(3)：正确性、效率、错误检测。(3): correctness, efficiency, error detection.

    冰湖FrozenLake(1)：正确性。(1): correctness.

两者都Both上下文在同一主干上进行评分——有何区别 师生是提示内容，不是模式。反馈意见contexts are scored on the same backbone — what distinguishes teacher from student is the prompt content, not the model. sdpo-gt是我们离线 SDPO 排名方法的预言家老师的消融。喜欢is an oracle-teacher ablation of our offline SDPO ranking method. LikeSDPOsdpo，它在两个上下文下对完全相同的候选动作标记进行评分，并使用平均师生对数概率差作为动作得分。学生只能看到原始决策点。教师可以看到相同的状态以及来自缓存的事实卷展的特定于候选人的证据：紧接着的下一个状态、候选人之后的下一个专家操作以及紧凑的卷展结果摘要，例如成功状态、剩余专家步骤和最终奖励。存储的 GT 证据仅用作教师提示上下文。, it scores the exact same candidate action tokens under two contexts and uses the mean teacher–student log-probability difference as the action score. The student sees only the original decision point. The teacher sees the same state plus candidate-specific evidence from cached ground-truth rollouts: the immediate next state, the next expert action after the candidate, and a compact rollout outcome summary such as success status, remaining expert steps, and final reward. The stored GT evidence is used only as teacher prompt context.

direct-batched and direct-16 prepend Estimate ... for each datapoint below, wrap each example in ## Datapoint i, and ask for a comma-separated list of numeric Q-value estimates in datapoint order. direct-sequential instead sends one user turn per datapoint, headed ## Datapoint i of n, and asks the model to keep earlier estimates fixed while returning exactly one estimate for the current turn. The backend scores the continuations Yes and No; the method uses the post-minus-pre log probability of Yes. codegen-avg uses the same generation prompt for multiple independent samples and averages the resulting predictions over valid generated functions. For the base sdpo method, the feedback text is the serialized resulting state for the candidate action when next-state feedback is enabled; otherwise the prompt emits [No explicit feedback was available for this action.]. The same candidate action is scored in the student and teacher contexts; the method uses teacher-minus-student mean token log probability. The runtime headings and labels specialize to the environment. For example, TerminalBench uses shell-response, expert-command, verifier-success, and verifier-reward labels; OpenApps, ALFWorld, and FrozenLake use the corresponding browser, household-command, or grid-move labels.

Appendix D Model Details

We used six instruction-tuned LLMs. All runs used a maximum context length of 262,144 tokens, nucleus sampling with p=0.95p=0.95, and a thinking budget of 6,144 tokens. Standard value-prediction runs used a maximum generation length of 8,192 tokens; code-generation runs used 14,336 tokens.
